title: Multiracial students make up 8.1% of Seven Bridges Middle School enrollment for 2025-26
text:
Seven Bridges Middle School counted 41 multiracial students among its enrollment for the 2025-26 school year—an increase of 17.1% from the prior year, New York State Education Department data shows.
Out of a total 507 students enrolled, 8.1% identified as multiracial, making this group the school’s third-largest ethnicity for the year.
Seven Bridges Middle School, situated in Chappaqua, operates as part of the Chappaqua Central School District, which has its central office in the same community.
Of the district’s six schools, Horace Greeley High School saw the largest number of multiracial students enrolled at that time, reporting 61 students.
World Population Review found that New York’s public school system was ranked second nationally overall , though it placed 31st for K-12 performance.
